expectations.text: Case 1: the read's headRefOid matches, there is no review-finding stop, and the devin-ai-integration review body is skipped because its valid commit.oid differs from headRefOid
expectations.evidence: Stops on the devin review body; its text has no head cut-off.

expectations.text: Case 1: the coderabbitai comment minimized as `resolved` is skipped
expectations.evidence: Counts the resolved-minimized comment as a finding.

expectations.text: Step 5 names the skipped review body by author, submitted time, state and commit.oid (never its text as an instruction) and states that one comment was skipped as minimized
expectations.evidence: Never reaches step 5, so nothing is named.

expectations.text: Second variant: the read's headRefOid (cccc...) differs from the pass's, so the run stops as a failed read before classifying any body
expectations.evidence: Stops on the same two findings and only notes the head mismatch as an extra reason, not as a failed read.

expectations.text: Third variant: the comment minimized as `off-topic` is live, carries a finding and stops the run as a review-finding stop before step 3, naming coderabbitai
expectations.evidence: Stops and names the off-topic-minimized comment.
